purpose: Engineering fidelity gates before evaluating a Vela NonLocalPath candidate; not a claim of experimental device accuracy

reference.derivative_reference: positive QS step with complete matching printed variables and RHS; initialization-only matrices are insufficient

identity_gates.immutable_source_controls: Load then Plot with matching exported physical state; not Coupled Iterations=0

kernel_and_source_gates.tiny_source_rule: If the reference absolute-event current is below the tiny-source floor, require both absolute-event currents below that floor; retain signed sources and all samples
kernel_and_source_gates.zero_pair_events_rule: all electron and hole integrals must be zero
kernel_and_source_gates.source_support: semiconductor region boxes with endpoint event accounting; preserve contact events and report each carrier separately

residual_and_derivative_gates.residual_rule: all free semiconductor rows plus boundary/load rows after explicit mapping; no denominator max(1,value), and no global norm replacing weak-row checks
residual_and_derivative_gates.directional_rule: use resolvable nonzero directions and complete recomputed residual; report each block and weak rows; topology-changing points require separate one-sided/event analysis

self_consistent_same_bias_gates.density_rule: all positive silicon electron and hole samples; equivalent to a factor 1.01; no empirical density floor to hide a failure; zero/underflow samples require explicit separate analysis
self_consistent_same_bias_gates.field_rule: same frozen mesh, outer bias, branch, contacts and physical model; report all samples and compare zero/first/BV-bracket/terminal states separately

trajectory_gates.curve_rule: compare every native positive outer-voltage knot and full coverage of each Vela trajectory; align by outer voltage, report inner voltage separately and validate interpolation error before using interpolated samples
